entities.summary: Ulf Ekman is a former charismatic pastor and the founder of the Livets Ord organization in Sweden, which brought the Word of Faith movement to that country. Ekman is now a Catholic. Ekman is married to Birgitta Ekman and has four sons: Aron, Jonathan Ekman, Samuel, and Benjamin.
